Topics covered in this PDF

MSOE-004 (Urban Sociology) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Urban sociology, ecological perspective, cities in India, urbanisation trends
  • West Bengal Model, family and urbanisation, liberalisation and occupations, slums, urban planning

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: answer any five questions, selecting at least two from each section, about 500 words each, 20 marks each, maximum marks 100
  • Section I: questions 1 to 5. Section II: questions 6 to 10

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
